verdict.rationale: BVNK's docs include an "api-explorer" section with per-endpoint and per-webhook reference pages. A demo page also shows API endpoint schemas and examples embedded in guides via `<ApiSchema>` and `<ApiExample>` components, so a structured API reference with examples is documented. Nothing in the pack says these examples can be executed from the browser. missing for 10: explicit evidence of runnable/try-it request execution in the reference, documentation of interactive features such as auth injection or sandbox calls from the explorer, independent or hands-on corroboration.
